findings.evidenceJa: アーチャーの魔術
findings.governingReading: Archer’s Magecraft
findings.explanation: The technical, learnable category Magecraft is again collapsed into Magic.

findings.highlight: I open my mouth in surprise
findings.evidenceJa: ぽかん、と口を開く
findings.governingReading: My mouth falls open
findings.explanation: The visible blank reaction is assigned a definite emotion.

findings.highlight: You said you’re going to fight him
findings.evidenceJa: そんなふざけたコト口走った
findings.governingReading: you blurted out something that absurd
findings.explanation: Rin’s condemnation of the reckless outburst and its involuntary delivery disappear.

findings.highlight: I might have the best luck against him
findings.evidenceJa: 一番俺に可能性がある
findings.governingReading: I have the best chance against him
findings.explanation: A tactical probability becomes personal luck.

findings.highlight: reproduce all the Noble Phantasms he takes out
findings.evidenceJa: ヤツが繰り出した分だけ、片っ端から複製すればいい
findings.governingReading: copy every weapon he deploys, one after another
findings.explanation: The reactive one-for-one mechanism and exhaustive sequence are weakened.

findings.highlight: Heroic spirit Emiya would be a complete match for him
findings.evidenceJa: 英霊エミヤに対してだけは互角の戦いをせざるを得ない
findings.governingReading: against Heroic Spirit Emiya alone, he is forced to fight on equal terms
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh’s forced loss of his normal advantage becomes a static matchup rating.

findings.highlight: I can barely manage to project one of Archer’s swords
findings.evidenceJa: アーチャーの剣を一本投影するだけでボロが出る
findings.governingReading: my body already starts coming apart from projecting just one of Archer’s swords
findings.explanation: The physical breakdown caused by one projection becomes generic difficulty.

findings.highlight: I don’t have enough magical energy
findings.evidenceJa: 魔力も持たない
findings.governingReading: my magical energy would never last
findings.explanation: A depletion-over-time limit becomes an initially insufficient quantity.

findings.evidenceJa: 固有結界から漏れた物にすぎない
findings.governingReading: are merely things that have leaked out of your Reality Marble
findings.explanation: The specific overflow mechanism behind Strengthening and Projection becomes generic derivation.

findings.highlight: it’ll be a piece of cake
findings.evidenceJa: 驚くぐらい簡単に歯車がかみ合う
findings.governingReading: the gears will mesh with surprising ease
findings.explanation: Rin’s mechanical model of Shirou’s abilities locking into place becomes slang for low difficulty.

findings.evidenceJa: 魔術回路を鍛えていった
findings.governingReading: trained his Magic Circuits
findings.explanation: Archer’s developed circuit system is reduced to one circuit.

findings.highlight: I don’t have a magical element
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術の素養がない
findings.governingReading: I have no natural aptitude for Magecraft
findings.explanation: A lack of aptitude becomes possession of no undefined “magical element.”

findings.highlight: I just happened to pick an improbable one
findings.evidenceJa: 可能性の低いものを取捨選択していただけ
findings.governingReading: I was only sorting through and eliminating the less viable options
findings.explanation: Rin’s systematic rejection of weak methods is reversed into arbitrarily selecting one.

findings.evidenceJa: わたしと貴方の問題
findings.governingReading: it concerns you and me
findings.explanation: The object of the preposition is put in the nominative case.

findings.highlight: even if my magical energy is depleted
findings.evidenceJa: 私の魔力が多少減っても
findings.governingReading: even if my magical energy is reduced somewhat
findings.explanation: A modest reduction is made complete depletion.

findings.highlight: I’ll still be able to fight
findings.evidenceJa: 戦力は拮抗する
findings.governingReading: our overall fighting strength will remain balanced
findings.explanation: A comparison of the two sides’ total forces is reassigned to Rin’s personal ability to fight.

findings.highlight: our chances of success might be pretty high
findings.evidenceJa: 勝算は充分にあるだろう
findings.governingReading: we should have ample prospects of victory
findings.explanation: Strongly sufficient odds are weakened by two layers of uncertainty.

findings.evidenceJa: 顔色はあまり明るくない
findings.governingReading: Her expression is far from bright
findings.explanation: An observable troubled expression is promoted into stated unhappiness.

findings.evidenceJa: 秘奥に“達した”時
findings.governingReading: attains the ultimate mystery
findings.explanation: A singular culmination of generations of research becomes generic plural mysteries.

findings.evidenceJa: お互いに移植すれば
findings.governingReading: one another’s essence
findings.explanation: A missing letter turns “another” into the flower-bearing part of a stamen.

findings.highlight: A person who gives up their Magic Circuits
findings.evidenceJa: 移植する魔術回路を提供する人間
findings.governingReading: The person who supplies the Magic Circuits to be transplanted
findings.explanation: Supplying the transplanted portion becomes surrendering all circuits.

findings.highlight: giving up their status as a magus
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術師としての完成を放棄する
findings.governingReading: abandoning their own completion as a magus
findings.explanation: Loss of the family’s cultivated magical culmination becomes loss of social or categorical status.

findings.highlight: if this will settle things, then I won’t hesitate
findings.evidenceJa: それで済むのなら話は早い
findings.governingReading: if that is all it costs, the matter is simple
findings.explanation: mirror moon adds a declaration of resolve while blurring Shirou’s assessment of the bounded cost.

findings.highlight: I need to completely open my Magic Circuits
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術回路を全開にしてようやく追いつけるかどうか
findings.governingReading: even opening every Magic Circuit fully may only barely be enough
findings.explanation: The uncertain extreme requirement for Reality Marble deployment becomes a sufficient instruction.

findings.highlight: if it was something like a familiar contracting ritual
findings.evidenceJa: 使い魔の契約ほど形式化していれば
findings.governingReading: if it were formalized to the degree of a familiar contract
findings.explanation: Safety arising from a standardized, formalized procedure becomes mere resemblance to a ritual.

findings.evidenceJa: 惜しい不正解
findings.governingReading: a close but incorrect answer
findings.explanation: Rin’s playful grading of the option as nearly right becomes a severe judgment.

findings.highlight: as the family’s head spends a lifetime giving intangible magic a form
findings.evidenceJa: その代の当主が一生かけて形にした
findings.governingReading: given form over the lifetime of each generation’s family head
findings.explanation: The accumulated work of successive heads is rendered as an unanchored present-tense action.

findings.highlight: not really a part of me
findings.evidenceJa: 術者そのものでもない
findings.governingReading: not identical with the practitioner herself
findings.explanation: A technical distinction between crest and magus is reduced to bodily part-whole language.

findings.highlight: this time for sure there’s no way I’m gonna screw up at the crucial moment
findings.evidenceJa: ここ一番の失敗も、今回ばかりはねじ伏せてやる
findings.governingReading: this time, I will overpower even my tendency to fail at the crucial moment
findings.explanation: Rin’s determination to overcome a known weakness becomes denial that failure is possible.

findings.highlight: it was wrong of me to be worried
findings.evidenceJa: 余計な気遣いは無粋
findings.governingReading: further solicitude would only be tactless
findings.explanation: Shirou recognizes that concern would disrespect Rin’s resolve; the English turns this into simple moral error.

findings.evidenceJa: 魔術刻印を削る
findings.governingReading: shaving away part of her Magic Crest
findings.explanation: Partial sacrifice becomes removal of the whole crest.

findings.evidenceJa: 一族の悲願を後退させる
findings.governingReading: set back her family’s long-cherished ambition
findings.explanation: A reversible setback becomes total erasure, while the inherited project becomes a desire.

findings.evidenceJa: 物分かりいい顔
findings.governingReading: suddenly understanding expression
findings.explanation: Rin reacts to Shirou grasping her resolve; the English invents sympathy.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka’s expression as she showed sincere concern
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂の表情
findings.governingReading: the expression, explicitly read as her true feelings, that revealed Tohsaka’s concern
findings.explanation: The ruby reading contrasts Rin’s public mask with an unguarded true expression; that distinction disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 人並み外れていいヤツ
findings.governingReading: an extraordinarily good person
findings.explanation: Shirou’s emphatic praise becomes faintly statistical approval.

findings.evidenceJa: 精一杯の信頼で応えよう
findings.governingReading: answer her with all the trust I can give
findings.explanation: Relational trust in Rin becomes Shirou’s personal confidence.

findings.highlight: how thick you can be, Emiya-kun
findings.evidenceJa: 衛宮くんの巡りの悪さ
findings.governingReading: how wretched your timing can be, Emiya-kun
findings.explanation: Rin’s complaint about Shirou’s ill-timed confession becomes an insult to his intelligence.

findings.highlight: sitting on the bed with her face down
findings.evidenceJa: 俯き加減でベッドに座り
findings.governingReading: sitting on the bed with her head slightly lowered
findings.explanation: The English suggests a prone facial position rather than a lowered gaze.

findings.evidenceJa: 扇情的だと思う
findings.governingReading: I find them sexually provocative
findings.explanation: Shirou’s explicit erotic perception becomes the false-friend “sensational.”

findings.highlight: I don’t think that leaves much room for weird ideas or misunderstandings
findings.evidenceJa: 誤解しようのない、間違いようのない事実
findings.governingReading: an unmistakable fact admitting no other interpretation
findings.explanation: The Japanese says Rin undressing is impossible to misread; the English says it leaves little room for the very erotic inference Shirou is making.

findings.evidenceJa: 高度な共感状態
findings.governingReading: a highly synchronized empathic state
findings.explanation: A technical state of mutual resonance becomes elevated pity or fellow-feeling.

findings.evidenceJa: 余分な雑念
findings.governingReading: extraneous distracting thoughts
findings.explanation: Shirou’s immediate distraction is moralized into worldly attachment.

findings.evidenceJa: む
findings.governingReading: Hm
findings.explanation: A neutral, puzzled murmur is turned into displeasure.

findings.evidenceJa: あられもない姿
findings.governingReading: in an indecent state of undress
findings.explanation: The hypothetical exposure is recast as a choice of immodest clothing.

findings.evidenceJa: うわずってしまいそうだ
findings.governingReading: my voice feels ready to pitch upward
findings.explanation: A specific involuntary vocal reaction becomes other people’s inferred impression.

findings.evidenceJa: 浮つきかけた心を引き締める
findings.governingReading: I rein in my heart as it begins to flutter
findings.explanation: Emotional and bodily excitement becomes an unnatural cognitive action.

findings.evidenceJa: 同調したあとに
findings.governingReading: After we synchronize
findings.explanation: A technical synchronization process becomes mutual fellow-feeling.

findings.highlight: I’m used to that kind of chaos
findings.evidenceJa: そういう荒事には慣れてる
findings.governingReading: I am accustomed to rough procedures like that
findings.explanation: Shirou’s experience with bodily trauma becomes experience of general disorder.

findings.evidenceJa: 吐息だけでなく
findings.governingReading: Not merely her breath
findings.explanation: The English invents depth and confuses continuous close breathing with a deliberate inhalation.

findings.evidenceJa: Vogel das
findings.governingReading: the ruby over “das” reads 招来, summon
findings.explanation: The incantation’s explicit Japanese reading means summoning; “engender” changes the ritual action.

findings.evidenceJa: Benutz den
findings.governingReading: the ruby over “den” reads 刻印制御, Crest control
findings.explanation: Control of the Magic Crest becomes merely restricting it.

findings.evidenceJa: in dem
findings.governingReading: the ruby over “dem” reads 第十六, sixteenth
findings.explanation: mirror moon changes the incantation’s ordinal from 16th to 60th.

findings.evidenceJa: 舌が空虚な味を感じた
findings.governingReading: my tongue perceives an empty taste
findings.explanation: A deliberately paradoxical sensory impression is flattened into absence of sensation.

findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂の肌が触れているように熱く感じる
findings.governingReading: I feel heat as though Tohsaka’s skin were touching mine
findings.explanation: A hallucinatory comparison in Shirou’s sensation becomes definite contact initiated by Rin.

findings.highlight: I hallucinate someone gripping my heart
findings.evidenceJa: 心臓が誰かに握られている幻視痛
findings.governingReading: a phantom pain as though someone were gripping my heart
findings.explanation: The operative pain is recast as visual or cognitive hallucination.

findings.highlight: I imagine myself gripping someone’s heart
findings.evidenceJa: 誰かの心臓を握っている幻経験
findings.governingReading: a phantom experience of gripping another person’s heart
findings.explanation: An imposed, quasi-sensory shared experience becomes voluntary imagination.

findings.highlight: That breathing sounds like someone is in pain
findings.evidenceJa: 漏れる息が切なげだった
findings.governingReading: the escaping breath sounds plaintive and aching
findings.explanation: An emotionally charged quality is narrowed to physical pain.

findings.highlight: I know it’s not my own breathing I’m hearing, so I listen carefully
findings.evidenceJa: 自分の吐息ではないと分かっていながら、つい耳を傾けてしまう
findings.governingReading: Although I know it is not my own breath, I cannot help listening
findings.explanation: A concessive relation becomes the reason Shirou deliberately listens.

findings.evidenceJa: 自分を見失った
findings.governingReading: losing my sense of self
findings.explanation: Dissolution of identity becomes a visual tracking failure.

findings.evidenceJa: いかな面積をもつ平面であれ
findings.governingReading: any plane, however great its area
findings.explanation: An abstract geometric plane becomes a physical object.

findings.highlight: being shut up deeper and deeper
findings.evidenceJa: 内へ内へと閉じていく
findings.governingReading: closing and folding ever farther inward
findings.explanation: “Shut up” produces the wrong idiom and obscures the recursive contraction.

findings.highlight: my arms were already folded up
findings.evidenceJa: 腕なんてとっくに折りたたまれているのでない
findings.governingReading: my arms have long since been folded away and no longer exist
findings.explanation: The loss of limbs is weakened into their merely folded state.

findings.highlight: I got rid of the excess things
findings.evidenceJa: 余分なもの、此処では無くてもいいものを削られてきた
findings.governingReading: extraneous parts unnecessary here have been stripped from me
findings.explanation: External disassembly is reassigned to Shirou’s own agency.

findings.highlight: the entire shape is peaceful and complete
findings.evidenceJa: カタチそのものが静かで、完結している
findings.governingReading: the form itself is still, self-contained, and complete
findings.explanation: Structural stillness is turned into an emotional atmosphere.

findings.evidenceJa: 永い年月
findings.governingReading: long years
findings.explanation: The Magic Crest’s generational formation is shortened by introducing months.

findings.evidenceJa: ひときわ大きな時間が揺れる
findings.governingReading: An exceptionally great mass of time trembles
findings.explanation: Both the motion and the crest-memory image are replaced.

findings.highlight: draws the design of the foreign substance
findings.evidenceJa: 異物の意図を汲み上げる
findings.governingReading: draws up and comprehends the foreign substance’s intent
findings.explanation: The crest responding to Shirou’s intent becomes extracting a visual design.

findings.highlight: being sent to a holiday villa
findings.evidenceJa: 別荘に置いて行かれた
findings.governingReading: being left behind at a villa
findings.explanation: Rin’s childhood abandonment is softened into purposeful travel arranged for her.

findings.evidenceJa: 戦いが始まる
findings.governingReading: because the battle was about to begin
findings.explanation: The Holy Grail War’s concrete danger becomes generic conflict.

findings.evidenceJa: 侵食を
findings.governingReading: erosion
findings.explanation: The fragment names the process; mirror moon supplies Shirou as its definite object.

findings.evidenceJa: トラツグミ
findings.governingReading: scaly thrush
findings.explanation: The specific bird and its eerie cultural association are genericized.

findings.highlight: As if it is someone else’s concern
findings.evidenceJa: 他人事のように
findings.governingReading: as though it were happening to someone else
findings.explanation: Dissociation from one’s own mutilation becomes indifference to a concern.

findings.highlight: being locked up, bound, dismembered, disassembled, and played with
findings.evidenceJa: 圧縮され
findings.governingReading: locked, bound, divided, dismantled, compressed, and toyed with
findings.explanation: Compression disappears from the ordered mutilation sequence.

findings.highlight: She holds in this level of discomfort
findings.evidenceJa: 体に棲まわせて
findings.governingReading: she lives with this revulsion dwelling inside her body
findings.explanation: Rin’s ongoing embodied burden becomes emotional suppression.

findings.highlight: One meeting that filled her heart with longing
findings.evidenceJa: 胸を焦がすような出会い
findings.governingReading: an encounter that seemed to scorch her heart
findings.explanation: The memory’s intense effect is assigned the specific emotion of longing.

findings.evidenceJa: 誰かが校庭を走っていた
findings.governingReading: Someone kept running toward the bar
findings.explanation: The memory initially withholds the athlete’s identity; mirror moon prematurely makes the person male.

findings.highlight: The world is returning to completion
findings.evidenceJa: 世界は完全に戻っていく
findings.governingReading: The world is restoring itself completely
findings.explanation: Restoration to the outside world becomes movement toward an abstract completed state.

findings.evidenceJa: 急速に蒸発していく
findings.governingReading: rapidly evaporates
findings.explanation: The speed and physical metaphor of Shirou’s dissolving consciousness disappear.

findings.highlight: a bubble bursting on the surface of the sea
findings.evidenceJa: 海面に消える泡
findings.governingReading: a bubble vanishing into the surface of the sea
findings.explanation: Gradual dissolution back into the surrounding medium becomes a rupture.

findings.highlight: I open my eyes and look around aimlessly
findings.evidenceJa: 開けた目蓋が、ぼんやりと周囲を捉える
findings.governingReading: My half-opened eyes dimly take in my surroundings
findings.explanation: Involuntary, impaired perception becomes purposeless visual action.

findings.evidenceJa: ちゃんといるじゃないか、遠坂
findings.governingReading: Tohsaka is still properly here
findings.explanation: Shirou’s relieved confirmation that Rin is present and all right is weakened.

findings.highlight: A design is branded on my left shoulder
findings.evidenceJa: 左腕には一線
findings.governingReading: A single ornate line is branded along my left upper arm
findings.explanation: The transferred crest’s location and linear form are changed.

findings.evidenceJa: 荒々しさの象徴みたいに言われる
findings.governingReading: be called as though I were the very symbol of brutish wildness
findings.explanation: Shirou’s comic overanalysis of Rin calling him a beast disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 同調による共感状態
findings.governingReading: an empathic state produced by synchronization
findings.explanation: The procedure is again reduced to the false-friend “sympathized.”

findings.evidenceJa: 棒高跳びしてる
findings.governingReading: was pole-vaulting
findings.explanation: The Japanese explicitly names pole vaulting here; mirror moon changes the event to high jumping.

findings.evidenceJa: ヤツ
findings.governingReading: that person
findings.explanation: The remembered athlete remains ungendered locally; mirror moon makes the person male.

findings.highlight: a slash combined with a full swing
findings.evidenceJa: 居合いでありながらフルスイング
findings.governingReading: an iaijutsu draw delivered as a full swing
findings.explanation: The specific martial contradiction behind Rin’s pillow throw becomes generic slashing.

findings.evidenceJa: 会心の一撃
findings.governingReading: a perfectly executed, deeply satisfying blow
findings.explanation: The mock-battle praise of Rin’s exceptional hit is weakened to adequacy.

findings.evidenceJa: しゃくり上げるような枕アッパー
findings.governingReading: a scooping, rising pillow uppercut
findings.explanation: The attack’s exact motion is replaced by an inferred pain level.

findings.evidenceJa: だらしなくノックダウンする
findings.governingReading: I collapse in another limp, undignified knockout
findings.explanation: The comic physical manner of Shirou’s collapse disappears.

findings.highlight: I’ll look at your embarrassing memories next time
findings.evidenceJa: 恥ずかしい記憶を覗き返してやる
findings.governingReading: I will peek back into your embarrassing memories in return
findings.explanation: Rin’s promised retaliation becomes a neutral future act.

findings.highlight: I won’t go easy on you
findings.evidenceJa: 土下座をしても許さない
findings.governingReading: I will not forgive you even if you prostrate yourself
findings.explanation: Refusal of forgiveness becomes an unspecified refusal of leniency.

findings.evidenceJa: 廊下に放り出され
findings.governingReading: thrown out into the hallway
findings.explanation: The force and indignity of Rin’s ejection are weakened.

findings.evidenceJa: そんな他愛ないことを独りごちながら
findings.governingReading: muttering that harmless little thought to myself
findings.explanation: The thought is characterized as slight and innocuous; the English instead calls Shirou’s manner stupid.

findings.evidenceJa: 柳洞寺
findings.governingReading: Ryuudou Temple
findings.explanation: The specific destination is reduced to a generic temple at the countdown transition.

findings.highlight: her maximum capacity could reach a thousand
findings.evidenceJa: 供給してくれるモノさえあれば、最大許容量は千に届くかも知れない
findings.governingReading: provided something supplies her, her maximum holding capacity may reach one thousand
findings.explanation: The stated condition that Rin needs an external source to fill that capacity disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 強化一回
findings.governingReading: one use of Strengthening
findings.explanation: The named Magecraft operation is rendered as an unnatural count noun.

findings.evidenceJa: 投影一回
findings.governingReading: one use of Projection
findings.explanation: The named Magecraft operation is again rendered as an unnatural count noun.

findings.evidenceJa: 三十回、六十回と出来る
findings.governingReading: thirty, even sixty times
findings.explanation: The explicit scale of Rin’s support is replaced by an imprecise quantity.
